operating_notes.text: Received ISO 13485:2016 and ISO 9001:2015 certifications for 3D-printed sterile medical implants on 25 April 2026.
Executed loan agreement on 5 May 2026 granting up to ₹10 Cr loan at 10% p.a. to 50:50 JV JK Phillips LLP (prior outstanding ₹4.70 Cr).
Bagged approx. ₹4.46 Cr (incl. GST) domestic order from BrahMos Aerospace for manufacture of PCB Warhead Casing Assembly.
Shareholders approved 13 material related-party transactions for FY27 involving JK Phillips LLP, Allen Reinforced Plastics, and other group entities.
Executed Loan Agreement to lend up to ₹25 Cr at 10% p.a. for 3 years, unsecured, to wholly owned subsidiary JK Digital & Advance Systems; nil was outstanding to it before this loan.
Company met the 50-50 test under Section 45-IA of the RBI Act for NBFC criteria as of March 31, 2026, though management and consultants determined registration is not applicable.
Auditor issued a qualified opinion on consolidated FY26 accounts due to ₹4.03 Cr DTA recognition under Ind AS 12 and ₹0.49 Cr opex capitalisation.
Corrigendum rectified fair value gain on JK Urbanscapes Developers equity shares to ₹262.66 Cr (Rs. 26,265.71 Lakh).
Recognised provision for expected credit loss of ₹48.92 Cr (Rs. 4,892 lakh) against trade receivables in a subsidiary as an exceptional item in FY26.
Subsidiary JK Digital & Advance Systems obtained CDSCO Form MD-9 manufacturing licence (MFG/MD/2026/000784) for 8 categories of Class C implants under Neobone and Nubone brands.
